topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Got a call about a cancelled surprise. Figured it out before the words were all said. Sometimes, the silence in the line says more than what's spoken. Plans fall through, people get cold feet. Could be anything, but the why doesn't matter as much as you think. People flake, and it's not always personal. Told them it’s okay, that there’s a time and a place for everything, and today wasn’t the day. Kept it light, said we’d plan something better. Not everyone can handle the weight of surprises, but some things can't be helped. The world keeps spinning, after all.
